about_the_game:
For those who despise the unknown and are always ready for new discoveries, the Adventure Seeker pack offers everything you need for travelling around the world of Aura. 

Contains:

·    Elmar's Balm (×50)
Instantly restores 100% health. Perfect for any dangerous situation!

·    Melios' Tincture (×50)
Instantly restores 100% of the character's energy and mana. Your magical powers will always be under control.

·    Maiden’s Ticket (×25)
Allows you to teleport to any Maiden or install a portal to a pre-selected location. Take instant trips around the world!

·    Veronica's Ticket (×200)
Teleports the player to Maiden Veronica in Varlone. Quickly and without any unnecessary delays!

·    Mad Bumblebuzz Wings (×200)
Teleports the player to a random place within the current location. A great tool if you need to explore the location fast or escape from a dangerous situation.

·    Swiftness Potion (×50)
Increases your running speed by 30% for 10 minutes. Move fast and avoid enemies on your way!

All items are linked to the account and cannot be transferred or sold. After purchase, this DLC will appear in your Golden Chest on the character selection screen.
